rescue_bio:
I have rehomed and spay/nuter chip rabies & cat vacines since 1975 well over 10,000 in my lifetime! I'm a solo senior entrepreneur with vetting experience!

🐾 All kitties will be spay/nuter' fully vacinated & a chip & a rabies shot for permanent rehoming! All these loving Kittys are socialized with other kittys , dogs and lots of humans ! Especially with Seniors daily!!! I also work with South County Spay/Nuter Project in Renton, WA.


Last Litter Program!!!

Do you currently have a pregnant mama cat or kittens? Our Last Litter Program can help! 💛

The Last Litter Program is designed to break the cycle of kitten litters while supporting both cats and their caregivers. Here's how it works: if your cat has recently had, or is getting ready to have a litter, we can potentially care for her and find loving homes for the kittens AND ensure mom is spayed before going back home—so this can be her last litter.

🐾 Safe support for mom and babies
🐾 Adoption placement for kittens
🐾 Spay surgery for mom before returning home
rescue_pricing: Kitty vaccine cost $30 · Spay/neuter with chip and rabies vaccine $125
